title: Mayo Clinic Diabetes Diet Book
description: The incidence of Type Two Diabetes has doubled in the U.S. over the past decade. Excess weight suppresses the body's ability to use insulin. So, the best chance to slow the trend is to get more Americans serious about losing weight.
